name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.camera.IqKitScannerActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI camera Activity starts an image or barcode search from the live camera. It sends camera frames or detected barcodes for lookup and opens the result screen when a match is returned.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search with the camera or view matches returned by either SDK.
